newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Pactual manages Mesbla - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Pactual manages Mesbla - report.

text.p: Brazilian investment bank Pactual has taken over the management of troubled retail chain Mesbla as part of a plan to restructure the firm's 830 million reais ($810 million) debt, Gazeta Mercantil said.
Under the plan designed by Mesbla's main creditors, Pactual will have six months to renegotiate the debt with at least 85 percent of the firm's creditors, the newspaper said.
In addition, the firm also hired Jose Paulo Amaral, a Brazilian executive who specializes in the retail sector, to manage the company jointly with Pactual.
Neither Banco Pactual nor Mesbla's officials were immediately available to comment on the report.
